inference: Reuse original parent member predictions; no extra checkpoint training or test fitting; log voting overhead separately.
selection: Both methods declared before development results; no weight search, stacking, best-seed selection, or outcome-based test inclusion
test_calibration: Use the exact full-validation temperatures pinned by the parent, not out-of-fold temperatures. Hard votes use unchanged individual labels.
uncertainty: Use the parent paired group bootstrap draws; compare each ensemble mean macro F1 minus DeBERTa Base mean macro F1; soft NLL minus calibrated DeBERTa NLL is secondary. No hard-vote probability metrics.
